description: Nursing home inspection citations — Health inspection deficiencies for one US nursing home from CMS Care Compare: every citation in the window with survey date, F-tag, category, description, scope/severity code decoded (minimal harm / more than minimal / actual harm / immediate jeopardy; isolated / pattern / widespread), complaint vs standard survey, infection control, correction date; plus counts by category and severity and a verdict (FEW ISSUES / TYPICAL / MANY DEFICIENCIES / CONCERNING - ACTUAL HARM CITED / SERIOUS - IMMEDIATE JEOPARDY CITED). Params: ccn= (required; find it with /v1/health/nursing-home), years=1-10 (default 4). Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
